card.name: Ends of web addresses in links
card.fires_on: The last piece of a pasted web address, such as .htm or .html at the end of a URL, or random-looking characters inside a YouTube video ID. It appears in reference lists and link lists on general web text.

modes.label: File extension ending a URL
modes.description: The .htm or .html ending that closes a link just before the following text begins.

modes.label: Random characters in a YouTube ID
modes.description: A chunk of the jumbled letters and digits in a YouTube watch link.

card.plain: It lights up near the end of a web link, on the .htm or .html ending or on the scrambled video code.
